units.source_text: 自此以后，源氏公子暂赴宫中或参谒父皇，亦必心挂两头，

en.t: From then on, even when Prince Genji went briefly to the palace or paid respects to his imperial father, his heart was always pulled in two directions,

units.source_text: 眼前时时出现紫姬那可爱的面影，自己也觉得不可思议。

en.t: and the lovely image of Lady Murasaki kept appearing before his eyes, so often that he himself found it strange.

units.source_text: 以前往来的许多情人，此时都写信来申恨诉怨。

en.t: Many of the lovers he had visited before now sent letters reproaching him and pouring out their grievances.

units.source_text: 其中也有公子所最爱怜的人。

en.t: Among them were even women whom the prince had loved and cherished most dearly.
But now he had a new love,

units.source_text: 真所谓“豆蔻年华新共枕，岂宜一夜不同衾？”

en.t: just as the saying goes, When youth has newly shared a pillow, how could even one night be spent under separate quilts?
How could anyone expect him to be willing to leave her?

units.source_text: 因此他谢绝一切，只装作居丧志哀的模样，

en.t: So he declined everything, merely putting on the appearance of mourning and sorrow,

units.source_text: 回信中说：“身逢不幸，厌闻世事，且待忧思稍减，再当奉访。”

en.t: and wrote in reply, I have met with misfortune and cannot bear to hear of worldly affairs; when my grief has eased a little, I shall call on you again.

units.source_text: 便与紫姬片刻不离，悠悠度日。

en.t: Then he stayed at Lady Murasaki's side without parting from her for even a moment, passing the days at leisure.
